class.name: FellowSoundEvent
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: a sound as a game asks for it — its variations, how much its level and pitch vary, how many may play at once, how soon again, how important it is, its bus and how far it carries.
class.description: A resource played by a [FellowAudioDirector] ([method FellowAudioDirector.play], [method FellowAudioDirector.play_on]). Each time it plays, one of its [member streams] is picked ([member selection]: at random without the last one again, at random, or in turn), its level varied by up to [member volume_random_db] either way and its pitch by up to [member pitch_random_semitones]; it is not played while [member max_instances] of it play or within [member cooldown] of its last start, nor farther from the listener than [member max_distance]; when the director's voices are all taken, its [member priority] and how loud the listener would hear it decide whether it takes one. Spatial events play in an [AudioStreamPlayer3D] at a place (or following a node), the others in an [AudioStreamPlayer]. See [code]docs/decisions/0190-audio-director.md[/code].

method.name: get_audibility_db
method.description: The level a listener [param distance] metres away hears it at, in dB, before the variation: [member volume_db] and the attenuation (at most +3 dB, the player's [member AudioStreamPlayer3D.max_db]). The director compares voices by it.

members.member: As [member AudioStreamPlayer3D.attenuation_model]: 0 inverse distance, 1 inverse square, 2 logarithmic, 3 none.
The audio bus it plays on.
Not played again within this many seconds of its last start (the director's clock).
Not played farther than this from the listener, in metres, and inaudible beyond it as [member AudioStreamPlayer3D.max_distance] (0: no limit).
At most this many of it play at once; asked for more, it is not played (0: no limit).
Its pitch varies by up to this many semitones either way each time it plays (uniformly).
How important it is, 0 to 255: when the director's voices are all taken, a voice of lower priority (then a quieter one at the listener) gives its voice to it.
Played at a place in the world ([AudioStreamPlayer3D]); off: everywhere at once ([AudioStreamPlayer]).
Over [member max_instances], the oldest of its voices gives way (faded out in [member FellowAudioDirector.steal_fade]) instead of the new one being refused: footsteps, impacts.
The variations: one is played each time.
As [member AudioStreamPlayer3D.unit_size]: the distance at which the attenuation starts.

Kept as a virtual voice instead of being refused when there is no voice for it, given up when another takes its voice, or not started beyond [member max_distance] (and when it is carried out of reach while it plays): its time runs on, nothing is mixed, and it is resumed where it would be (a loop wrapped; a one-shot that ended is let go) when within reach and a voice is free. For loops — engines, machinery, ambiences (milestone 85).
Its level varies by up to this much either way each time it plays (uniformly), in dB.

constants.constant: At random, never the one played last.
